decided: Three parts of the program brief cannot be worked out from what orbit already records: what was built, the new places the user is asked something, and where the work left its stage's plan. The AI writes those three, in plain language, once for each change when it finishes building it; orbit puts together the rest of the brief from what it already records.
alternatives: the AI writes the three parts when the change is archived, after the last point a separate reader checks the AI's writing
orbit puts together the whole brief from what it records, leaving those three parts out
why: G5 asks that the user can sign off from the brief alone, which needs those three parts; written when building finishes, they are checked by the same reader that checks the AI's other records before the user sees them.

defines.definition: a fresh AI session given only the architecture doc and the records, which checks that each record can be understood without knowing the work
